STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_018400.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_018400.v · Open raw
module origen_018400 #(
    parameter WIDTH = 640,
    parameter HEIGHT = 480
) (
    input wire capture_rst,
    input wire pclk,
    input wire vsync,
    input wire href,
    input wire [7:0] d,
    output reg [15:0] tdata,
    output reg tvalid,
    output reg tlast,
    output reg tuser,
    input wire tready
);

    reg [15:0] d_latch;
    reg [1:0] wr_hold;
    reg [18:0] address;
    reg [9:0] pixel;
    
    wire [18:0] address_next = (address == WIDTH * HEIGHT - 1) ? 0 : address + 1;
    wire [9:0] pixel_next = (pixel == WIDTH - 1) ? 0 : pixel + 1;

    always @(posedge pclk) begin
        if (capture_rst || vsync) begin
            address <= 0;
            pixel <= 0;
            wr_hold <= 2'b00;
            d_latch <= 16'h0000;
            tvalid <= 1'b0;
            tlast <= 1'b0;
            tuser <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            d_latch <= {d_latch[7:0], d};
            wr_hold <= {wr_hold[0], (href && !wr_hold[0])};
            
            if (wr_hold[1] && tready) begin
                address <= address_next;
                pixel <= pixel_next;
                tdata <= {d_latch[15:11], d_latch[10:5], d_latch[4:0]};
                tvalid <= 1'b1;
                tlast <= (pixel_next == WIDTH - 1);
                tuser <= (address_next == 1);
            end else begin
                tvalid <= 1'b0;
                tlast <= 1'b0;
                tuser <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
